sources.document_date_note: A 1908 compilation covering 1618-1905; its entries draw on the works listed in its Quellenangabe (pp. 15-32). The compilation date is not an event date.
sources.dependency_note: A compiled secondary tabulation. By its own explanatory notes (pp. 45-47) it includes engagements of significant consequence or with at least 2,000 combined losses, places the winner on the left, assigns a winner even to indecisive battles, gives strengths as the forces available for the battle rather than only those engaged, and rounds figures up to 50 or 100. Arnold's machine-readable Bodart tables (arnold-bodart1908-*) reproduce the same work, so they are one family with it.
